name: surface-view-path-no-tab-state
description: A view of a plugin without surface.unload reads its tab state, and the page answers the call with the refusal that the tab state is not declared.
reason: The view calls reach the page as the notice view-call of a view that the host runs in a window, which the Go producer does not run (docs/spec/cases/page-wire/README.md#producer-runs).

error.message: view call tab.state.read: the tab state is not declared
